hook: I got tired of re-explaining my business to *AI*

altHook: My AI finally knows my prices

beats.text: So I gave it a Brain in Notion.
It knows my offers, my prices and how I sound.
Now every caption starts from what is true about my business.

caption: Business Brain is $47 at scrollyseo.com. It is a Notion template your ChatGPT or Claude fills in by interviewing you, then uses every time you ask for a caption, a DM reply or a plan for the week.

brief.source: Business Brain live product page scrollyseo.com/product/business-brain (checked 2026-10-10)
brief.reader: Small business owners who use AI for captions
brief.problem: They retype their business details in every chat
brief.outcome: Their AI starts from their real offers and voice
brief.mainPoint: One Notion Brain your AI reads every time
